summary: As Surfside Mayor in April 2024, Burkett acknowledged "people on both sides" of the Israel-Palestine conflict but centered his statement on condemning physical attacks on Jewish people and protecting the local Jewish community. His 2026 Florida gubernatorial platform addresses economy, healthcare, housing, and immigration but does not engage with Gaza, Israeli military policy, or Palestinian rights. The documented framing is Israel-centric, foregrounding Jewish safety rather than Palestinian justice.
